sentence: 患者接受了手术治疗跖骨病变。
original_english: The patient underwent a surgical procedure to treat a metatarsal condition.

sentence: 使用手术刀在足部皮肤上切开，随后对第一跖骨进行多次骨切割，使用骨锯和振动锯。
original_english: A scalpel was used to make an incision on the skin of the foot, followed by multiple osteotomies on the first metatarsal using a bone saw and an oscillating saw.

sentence: 随后对第一跖骨进行了钻孔手术。
original_english: A drilling procedure was then performed on the first metatarsal.
